# What should this catering job cost per guest — and how few guests can you take?

> Paste a catering cost sheet and get the per-guest price that hits your margin, food and labor percentages, the deposit, a guest-count tier table and the break-even guest count. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to price catering per person, and what a minimum guest count is for](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/catering-quote-calculator/catering-pricing-guide.html)
